fields.question: What are your opening hours?
fields.answer: We're open daily from 7am to 6pm, and until 3pm on public holidays.

fields.question: Do you take reservations?
fields.answer: We don't take reservations for groups under 6. For larger groups, message us at least a day ahead.

fields.question: Do you deliver?
fields.answer: No, we don't deliver: all orders are for self-collection from our studio at 35 Joo Chiat Place, Singapore 427757, during our collection hours (Monday to Saturday from 11am to 7pm, and Sunday from 11am to 4pm). If you'd like the flowers to go to someone else, you're welcome to book your own courier or a delivery app (such as Lalamove or Grab Express) to collect them from us: just give the driver your order number.

fields.question: Can I customise a bouquet?
fields.answer: No, sorry: we only make the bouquets and arrangements in our catalogue, as described, and can't customise them or make custom designs. Every order comes with a free greeting card with your message.

fields.question: Is your food halal?
fields.answer: We aren't halal-certified. We don't use pork or lard in any of our food or drinks, but our kitchen isn't certified and our suppliers aren't all certified either.

fields.question: Do you deliver?
fields.answer: We don't run our own delivery. You can order pickup through this chat, or find us on GrabFood and Foodpanda for delivery within about 5 km of Tiong Bahru (their prices are slightly higher).

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: For orders placed in this chat, we'll send you a PayNow QR code once your order is confirmed. In the café we accept cash, PayNow, NETS and Visa/Mastercard. We don't accept American Express.

fields.question: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
fields.answer: Our Kaya Toast Set is vegetarian (it contains eggs and dairy). The Pandan Chiffon Cake is dairy-free but contains eggs. We don't have any vegan food or drinks at the moment.

fields.question: Can I change the sugar level of my drink?
fields.answer: No, sorry: drinks ordered in this chat are always made our standard way. Kopi C has one spoon of sugar and is only mildly sweet; teh tarik is on the sweet side, because it's made with condensed milk.

fields.question: Do you cater for events or large orders?
fields.answer: We don't offer catering, but you can order as many of our menu items as you like in this chat, for pickup. For 20 items or more, please order at least a day ahead.

fields.question: Is there parking nearby?
fields.answer: There's no parking at the café itself. The nearest carpark is the HDB carpark at Block 55 Tiong Bahru Road, about 2 minutes' walk away, with coupon or Parking.sg parking.

fields.question: Do you have Wi-Fi and power sockets?
fields.answer: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available (ask our staff for the password) and there are power sockets at the counter seats. On weekends from 9am to 1pm we ask laptop users to limit their stay to 1 hour when it's busy.

fields.question: Are pets allowed?
fields.answer: Well-behaved dogs on a leash are welcome at our outdoor tables. Only service animals are allowed inside.

fields.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
fields.answer: You can change or cancel a pickup order through this chat up to 30 minutes before your pickup time. Pandan chiffon cake orders can be cancelled up to 12 hours before pickup, because we bake them to order.

fields.question: Where and when can I collect my order?
fields.answer: At our studio, 35 Joo Chiat Place, Singapore 427757, during our collection hours: Monday to Saturday from 11am to 7pm, and Sunday from 11am to 4pm. You choose your collection date when you order, and we'll message you when your order is ready. Please bring your order number. Street parking is available along Joo Chiat Place, and the nearest MRT stations are Eunos and Marine Parade (about a 10-minute walk). We're closed on the first two days of Chinese New Year.

fields.question: Can I collect my order on the same day?
fields.answer: Yes. Orders confirmed and paid before 12pm from Monday to Saturday can be collected the same day, from 4pm. This applies to fresh, dried and soap flowers, and to crochet flowers that are in stock. There's no same-day collection on Sundays, public holidays, or during the Valentine's Day and Mother's Day peak periods, when orders must be placed in advance.

fields.question: What are your opening hours?
fields.answer: Our studio is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 7pm, and Sunday from 10am to 4pm, for walk-ins and enquiries. Orders can be collected Monday to Saturday from 11am to 7pm, and Sunday from 11am to 4pm: our florists arrange the day's orders in the morning. We're closed on the first two days of Chinese New Year. You can message us here at any time: our assistant replies straight away, and our team follows up during opening hours.

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: We accept PayNow, and Visa, Mastercard and American Express cards through a secure payment link. At the studio we also take cash and NETS. Your order is confirmed once payment is received.

fields.question: How long do your flowers last?
fields.answer: It depends on the collection: fresh flowers last about 5 to 7 days with proper care; dried flowers keep their look for 1 to 2 years; preserved roses last 3 to 5 years; soap flowers last for years as a decoration (the scent fades after about 6 months); and crochet flowers last forever. Each product's details explain its care in full.

fields.question: How do I care for fresh flowers?
fields.answer: Remove the wrapping and the water pouch, trim 2 cm off each stem at an angle, and place the flowers in a clean vase with cool water and the flower food we include. Change the water and re-trim the stems every 2 days, and keep the vase away from direct sunlight, aircon vents and ripening fruit.

fields.question: Can someone else collect my order for me?
fields.answer: Yes. Just give them your order number and the name on the order. Couriers and delivery app drivers can collect for you in the same way. If an order isn't collected on its collection date, we keep it for you: fresh flowers in our cold room for up to 2 days (after that they start to fade), and everything else for up to 14 days.

fields.question: Can I change my collection date or time?
fields.answer: Yes, free of charge, up to 24 hours before your collection date: just message us. On the day itself, you can collect at any time during our collection hours. Fresh flower orders can't be postponed by more than 3 days once they've been arranged.

fields.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
fields.answer: You can cancel for a full refund up to 48 hours before your collection date. Within 48 hours, we can give you store credit for 50% of the order value, since the flowers may already be prepared. Please check your flowers when you collect them: if anything is wrong, tell us before you leave and we'll fix or replace it.

fields.question: Do you include a card with my message?
fields.answer: Yes, every order comes with a free greeting card. Your message can be up to 200 characters, and we print it in a handwritten-style font. If you'd like to stay anonymous, just leave your name off the message: we never tell the recipient who sent the flowers.

fields.question: Will I see a photo of my flowers before I collect them?
fields.answer: Yes. When your order is ready, we send you a photo here on WhatsApp, so you can see exactly what you'll be collecting.

fields.question: What if a flower in my order is out of stock?
fields.answer: Fresh flowers depend on the season and on flights, so occasionally a flower isn't available on your date. If so, we'll replace it with a flower of the same colour and style, of equal or higher value, and message you before we do. For bouquets of a single type of flower (such as roses or sunflowers), we'll always ask you first.

fields.question: Do you take corporate and bulk orders?
fields.answer: You can order any quantity of the items in our catalogue in this chat, at the listed prices, for collection from the studio. We don't offer bulk prices, custom tags or logos, or invoices. For large orders, please order at least 3 days ahead so we have enough flowers ready.

fields.question: Do you do wedding and event flowers?
fields.answer: No, sorry: we only sell the bouquets and arrangements in our catalogue. We don't make bridal bouquets or event décor.

fields.question: Do you run crochet flower workshops?
fields.answer: No, we don't run workshops at the moment.

fields.question: Are your flowers safe for people with allergies, and for pets?
fields.answer: For allergy sufferers, our crochet, soap and preserved flowers are the safest choice: they have no pollen. Among fresh flowers, roses and our pollen-free sunflowers are the gentlest. Some flowers, such as lilies, baby's breath, lavender and chamomile, can be harmful to cats and dogs if eaten. If the recipient has pets, check each product's information: it says whether the flowers are safe for cats and dogs.

fields.question: Can the card message be written in Chinese?
fields.answer: Yes! We can print card messages in Chinese, Malay or Tamil as well as English. Just type your message in the language you'd like when you order, and we'll print it in a matching font.

fields.question: Do you sell balloons to go with the flowers?
fields.answer: Not at the moment, sorry! We only sell flowers: everything we have is in our catalogue.

fields.question: Where is the studio?
fields.answer: Our studio is at 88 Tanjong Pagar Road, #03-01, a 3-minute walk from Tanjong Pagar MRT (exit A). There is paid parking at the Tanjong Pagar Plaza car park.

fields.question: How do I pay for my booking?
fields.answer: Once your booking is confirmed in the chat, we send you a payment link for a 30% deposit, by PayNow or card. The rest is paid on the day of your session.

fields.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
fields.answer: You can reschedule for free up to 48 hours before your session: just message us here. Deposits are refundable up to 7 days before the session.

fields.question: When do I get my photos?
fields.answer: Your edited photos are in your online gallery within 7 days of the session (newborn sessions within 10 days). You can download them all in full resolution.

fields.question: What should we wear?
fields.answer: Solid colours and soft neutrals photograph best; avoid big logos and neon. You are welcome to bring outfit changes: there is a changing room in the studio.

fields.question: Do you shoot outside the studio?
fields.answer: Yes: any session can be at a location within the city area (e.g. the Botanic Gardens or Tiong Bahru) at no extra cost, except Newborn Sessions, which are only in the studio.

fields.question: Do you deliver prints and frames?
fields.answer: Yes, anywhere in Singapore. Prints, frames, canvases and albums are made to order in our studio within 3 to 5 working days, then delivered in 1 to 2 working days. Delivery is free. We send you a photo of the finished piece before it ships.

fields.question: Can I order prints of photos taken elsewhere?
fields.answer: No, sorry: we only print photos from your own Lumen & Lens session, from your online gallery. Tell us the gallery name and photo numbers when you order.

fields.question: What if my print arrives damaged?
fields.answer: Send us a photo of it in this chat within 7 days of delivery and we will reprint and redeliver it free of charge.

fields.question: Can I collect my prints from the studio instead?
fields.answer: No, sorry: all print and frame orders are delivered, free of charge, to the address you give when you order.

fields.question: What are your opening hours?
fields.answer: Every day, including public holidays, from 9am to 9pm. Courts are rented by the hour, so the last booking starts at 8pm.

fields.question: How long can I book a court for?
fields.answer: Bookings are in 1-hour blocks, starting on the hour. For 2 hours, just book two back-to-back slots.

fields.question: Can I rent rackets and balls?
fields.answer: We don't rent equipment, sorry. But we sell a few rackets, shuttlecocks and tennis balls: order them in this chat and collect them from our front counter, or bring your own.

fields.question: Are the courts indoors?
fields.answer: The 2 badminton courts are indoors and air-conditioned. The 2 tennis courts are outdoors, with floodlights from 7pm.

fields.question: What happens to tennis bookings when it rains?
fields.answer: If it rains and the courts are unplayable, we move your booking to another time or refund it in full. Badminton courts are indoors and not affected.

fields.question: What is your cancellation policy?
fields.answer: Cancel or change for free up to 24 hours before your booking. Within 24 hours, we can only move it to another slot that is free.

fields.question: Is there parking and showers?
fields.answer: Yes: there is a car park next to the building ($1.20 an hour), and changing rooms with lockers and showers on level 1.
